steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.

args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ create screen, select the product CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Quantity Requested to 10, and select Plant Name (LOC-0001) for Delivery location; stop with the completed product row visible

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for selecting a specific product variant or delivery location.
Open the event-level Terms & Conditions interface.
Open the document upload control in the Terms & Conditions interface.
Attach the requested terms.pdf document.
Complete the document attachment flow.
Verify the attached document is listed before publishing.
